name: sepsis overview
title: Sepsis decision chart: recognise sepsis early from physiology, symptoms and high-risk groups, then act on three fronts at once: broad-spectrum antibiotics without delay, finding and controlling the source, and life support for failing organs (vasopressors when blood pressure does not respond to fluids)

root.title: A SICK patient: could this be SEPSIS?
lines: sepsis = life-threatening ORGAN DYSFUNCTION from a dysregulated host response to infection (bacteria, viruses, fungi)
an emergency: mortality 30–40% · the more organs fail, the likelier death

groups.title: 1 · RECOGNISE IT
lines: wherever you work: have a plan to NOT miss it

groups.title: 2 · Then act on ALL THREE at once

head: h
Early recognition
inflammation is no longer local
spot: • rapid decline in function, family concerned

head: h
Early antibiotics
NOTHING saves more lives
spot: about 8% ↑ mortality per HOUR of delay once hypotension starts
do: 1 · Cultures FIRST, only if they will not delay the dose
• whatever it takes to get it into the blood

head: h
Source control
find it fast, control it fast
do: • REMOVE the infected line or implant

head: h
Life support
invasive support for FAILING organs
spot: = SEPTIC SHOCK: arterioles dilate, capillaries leak
do: raise the BP without drowning the tissues in fluid (edema)
• lung: lung-protective ventilation, prone, extracorporeal membrane oxygenation (ECMO)
